findings.current:
“Will that do?”

The Beast Miao King asked, his eyes emitting a glacial light.

“Our first greeting.”
findings.defect: The Beast Miao King’s question, “What do you mean?”, is missing between his narration and Taekyung’s reply. The omission makes “Our first greeting” feel unprompted and loses a beat of the exchange.
findings.rationale: The source has the King ask “무엇을 말이냐?” before Taekyung replies “첫인사요.”
findings.replacement:
“Will that do?”

The Beast Miao King asked, his eyes emitting a glacial light. “What do you mean?”

“Our first greeting.”

summary: One brief question is omitted, weakening the exchange’s setup.
